plain_english_policy: This bill transfers exclusive authority over all civil and criminal litigation involving the State of Alabama from the Governor to the Attorney General.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would legally prohibit the Governor from initiating, directing, or appointing individuals to initiate any state-level civil or criminal proceedings. It establishes that only the Attorney General has the power to direct and control such litigation and investigations for the State of Alabama.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representatives Ford, McLaughlin, and Taylor affirmatively advanced this bill to codify Attorney General authority over state litigation.
evidence_quotes: "The Attorney General... is authorized to direct and control all civil and criminal litigation concerning the State of Alabama."
"the Governor shall not have the authority... to institute or direct the institution of a civil or criminal proceeding or investigation"
